mcpSpotlight.body: Ferry Agent also works from an AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT…) via MCP — search, add, and send your books from the conversation.

selfHosted.q: Does it run on my machine?
selfHosted.a: Yes. The core and your library stay on your machine. Nothing is stored on servers we control.

gatewayNeeded.q: Do I need personal access for free book sources?
gatewayNeeded.a: No. Gutenberg, Standard Ebooks and your uploads work right away. Personal access is only needed for sources that live on your own network.

readers.a: Kindle (sent by email), Kobo and cloud-linked devices, Tolino and browsers via a short-lived code, and any USB-connected reader.

myData.a: Yes. Your library, your devices, your delivery history — all stored on your own setup.

agent.a: Yes. A technical interface (API) uses the same sign-in as the dashboard, so something automated can search and deliver for you.

docs.metaDescription: Install your Ferry Agent personal access at home with Docker, in a single command.
docs.title: Install your personal access
docs.intro: Just one command to run: your Ferry Agent personal access is up and running in minutes.
docs.checklistItem1: Docker Desktop installed (or OrbStack on Mac)
docs.checklistItem2: An access created in the Ferry Agent dashboard
docs.step1Action: Open the Access page and click Create an access.
docs.step1Success: A connection code and an access key appear. Copy them now: they will never be shown again.
docs.step2Action: Download the Docker image with the button below. This is the only way to get it.
docs.step2Cta: Direct download of the Docker image
docs.step2UseFile: The .tar file can be imported directly into Docker Desktop or OrbStack. Once imported, continue to the next step.
docs.step2Success: The image appears in Docker Desktop or OrbStack.
docs.step3Action: Paste this command in the terminal. Replace CODE and KEY with the two codes shown once when you created the access (or copy the “Both codes together” block from the Access page).
docs.step3Hint: Both codes are required. The downloads folder is created automatically next to where you run the command.
docs.step3Success: On the Access page, your access shows as Connected.
docs.step4Action: Open this address in your browser, then add an indexer.
docs.step4Success: The Prowlarr page shows your indexer in the list.
docs.step5Action: Add this MCP URL to Claude, ChatGPT, or your favorite assistant to search, add, and send your books from the conversation:
docs.closingLine: Your books arrive on their own in your library.
docs.glossaryProwlarrDef: The program that manages your indexers and sends them to Ferry Agent.

docs.glossaryMagnetDef: A link that starts a download directly, without a .torrent file.
docs.glossaryGatewayDef: The program installed on your computer that connects it to Ferry Agent.
